visualBrief.coreEventZh: 悬空预约已解除，第一处阻断点修复完成，但整条链路尚未经自然运行验证
visualBrief.keyActionZh: 解除卡住的闸门悬空锁
visualBrief.resultZh: 闸门恢复空闲，归档箱已封存，但水道全程通畅尚待下一次潮汐验证
visualBrief.tensionZh: 局部修复已完成与整条链路验证缺失
visualBrief.industrialMetaphorZh: 运河闸门悬空预约解除
supportingSymbolsZh: 手持扳手站在闸门旁的工程师
已贴封条的木质归档箱
远处未见船只通过的静止水道
visualBrief.sceneDescriptionZh: 昏暗的运河闸室，工程师站在刚修好的闸门旁，手中扳手尚未放下，身后是一只已封存的归档木箱，远处水道延伸入雾中，尚未有船只驶来验证通畅
focalElementsEn: Engineer with wrench beside repaired canal lock gate
Sealed wooden archive crate with intact closure
Empty canal waterway extending into mist without vessels
visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A canal engineer stands beside a heavy iron lock gate, wrench in hand, in dim industrial light. Behind him rests a sealed wooden crate with intact metal clasps. The canal waterway stretches into fog beyond, still and empty, awaiting the next vessel to prove the route is truly clear.
